source_en:
Our {%STRING0} carrying a pioneer and a soldier is on the high seas,
Your Excellency.  If we navigate to the west ({left arrow}), we'll
probably find land.  If we sail to the east ({right arrow}), we can
return to port.
zh_hant: 閣下，我們的{%STRING0}正載著一名前鋒和一名士兵航行在公海上。若向西（{左方向鍵}）航行，應該能找到陸地；若向東（{右方向鍵}）航行，就能返回港口。
notes: 說明語料草稿；檔案來源已確認，執行事件與中文安全矩形尚未驗證

source_en: We've found uncharted land, Excellency.  To put the colonists ashore,\nmove the ship toward land and choose {Make Landfall} from the menu.
zh_hant: 閣下，我們發現了尚未繪入地圖的陸地。要讓殖民地居民上岸，請將船駛向陸地，再從選單選擇{登陸}。
notes: 說明語料草稿；檔案來源已確認，執行事件與中文安全矩形尚未驗證

source_en: The abundance of {%STRING0} in this area makes this a good place to\nstart our first colony.  To begin a colony, Sire, press the '{B}' key.
zh_hant: 這一帶盛產{%STRING0}，很適合建立第一座殖民領地。要建立殖民領地，閣下請按「{B}」鍵。
notes: 說明語料草稿；檔案來源已確認，執行事件與中文安全矩形尚未驗證

source_en:
On the {Colony Screen}, you can decide what the colonists in this colony
should be doing.  Our colonist is currently producing {%STRING0}.  He
could, for instance, produce {%STRING1} instead.  To change his job,
select him to bring up the {Jobs Menu}, then choose what you want him
to do.  You can also drag him to a different square, or into one of the
buildings in the colony.  To take a colonist out of a colony, drag him
to the fence (near the water on the colony picture).
zh_hant: 在{殖民領地畫面}，您可以安排殖民地居民的工作。這位殖民地居民目前生產{%STRING0}；他也可以改為生產{%STRING1}。若要調整工作，選取他以開啟{工作選單}，再選擇新工作。您也可以把他拖到另一個方格，或拖入殖民領地的建築。若要讓殖民地居民離開殖民領地，請把他拖到圍欄處（殖民領地圖片靠水的一側）。
notes: 說明語料草稿；檔案來源已確認，執行事件與中文安全矩形尚未驗證

source_en: Excellency, there are {%STRING1} ready to join our colony on the docks\nin {%STRING0} (Europe).  If we send our ship there they will gladly\nset sail with us and become useful members of our community.
zh_hant: 閣下，有{%STRING1}正在{%STRING0}（歐洲）的碼頭，準備加入我們的殖民領地。只要派船前往，他們就願意隨船出航，成為社群的一員。
notes: 說明語料草稿；檔案來源已確認，執行事件與中文安全矩形尚未驗證

source_en: Sire, there are {%NUMBER0} {%STRING0} in {%STRING1}.  If we move a ship\ninto %STRING1, we can pick up this cargo and take it back to %STRING2 in\nEurope, where we can sell it for a profit.
zh_hant: 閣下，{%NUMBER0}份{%STRING0}存放在{%STRING1}。把船駛入%STRING1，就能裝載這批貨物，運回歐洲的%STRING2出售獲利。
notes: 說明語料草稿；檔案來源已確認，執行事件與中文安全矩形尚未驗證

source_en:
%STRING0 is growing rapidly, Your Excellency, and we may want to
consider building a {Stockade} to protect it from harm.  To build
something, we must first make one of our colonists a {Lumberjack}
and have him chop {Lumber} in a forested square.  Then, we make
a colonist a {Carpenter}, who makes buildings out of the lumber.
Finally, we tell the carpenter what to build.  We do this by clicking
on the blue 'Hammer' button at the lower right of the screen.  This
shows us what we are currently building, and allows us to change it
if we want.
zh_hant: 閣下，%STRING0正迅速發展，我們不妨建造{柵欄}保護它。要興建建築，先指派一名殖民地居民當{伐木工人}，在森林方格砍伐{木材}；再指派一名{木匠}用木材建造。最後，告訴木匠要建什麼：點選畫面右下角藍色的「錘子」按鈕，即可查看目前建造項目並改選。
notes: 說明語料草稿；檔案來源已確認，執行事件與中文安全矩形尚未驗證

source_en: This %STRING0 has no specialty profession.  If we move him into a\nfriendly native village, the indians may be willing to teach him a\nnew skill.
zh_hant: 這位%STRING0沒有專長技能。若讓他進入友好的原住民村莊，印地安人可能願意教他一項新技能。
notes: 說明語料草稿；檔案來源已確認，執行事件與中文安全矩形尚未驗證

source_en:
This looks like a good place for a {road}.  Our {pioneers} will build
roads in a square if you press the '{R}' key. If we build a road here,
our fur, lumber, ore, and silver production in this square will be
increased.  Our units also move faster when they are moving
along a road.
zh_hant: 這裡很適合修築{道路}。讓{前鋒}在此方格按「{R}」鍵即可修路。道路能提高此方格的毛皮、木材、礦石和白銀產量，也讓單位沿路移動得更快。
notes: 說明語料草稿；檔案來源已確認，執行事件與中文安全矩形尚未驗證

source_en:
This looks like a good place to {plow} or {clear}.  Our {pioneers} will plow
the fields in a square if you press the '{P}' key.  Plowing a square
increases its food, tobacco, cotton, and sugar production by one.
Plowing a {forest} square causes the forest to be {cleared}, making room
for more agriculture.
zh_hant: 這裡很適合{耕地}或{清除森林}。讓{前鋒}在此方格按「{P}」鍵即可開墾。開墾可使食物、煙草、棉花和蔗糖的產量各增加一單位。在{森林}方格開墾則會{清除}森林，騰出農地。
notes: 說明語料草稿；檔案來源已確認，執行事件與中文安全矩形尚未驗證

source_en:
Our ship, a {%STRING0}, is one of our most valuable units.  We can use
it to explore the uncharted vastness of the New World, to carry our cargo
home to %STRING1 for sale, and to bring new immigrants from Europe.  You
can move the ship normally with the arrow keys.  You can also send it to
the port of your choice by pressing the '{G}' key.
zh_hant: 我們的{%STRING0}是最珍貴的單位之一。它能探索新世界未知的海域、把貨物運回%STRING1出售，也能從歐洲帶來新移民。您可以用方向鍵正常駕船，或按「{G}」鍵指定目的港。
notes: 說明語料草稿；檔案來源已確認，執行事件與中文安全矩形尚未驗證

source_en:
Our ship has arrived in %STRING0, Your Excellency, and is waiting
for cargo!  The blue boxes across the bottom of the screen list the
cargo available in our warehouse.  To load cargo onto the ship, use
the mouse to drag it from the warehouse into one of the ship's cargo
holds (the small boxes underneath the ship's picture).  Once the ship
is loaded, you can return to the main map (press '{ESC}').  Then, on
the ship's next turn, you can send it to Europe by pressing '{G}'.
zh_hant: 閣下，我們的船已抵達%STRING0，正在等候裝貨！畫面底部的藍色方框列出倉庫中的貨物。要裝船，請用滑鼠把貨物從倉庫拖到船上的貨艙（船隻圖片下方的小方框）。裝妥後，按「{ESC}」返回主地圖；輪到這艘船的下一回合時，再按「{G}」送它前往歐洲。
notes: 說明語料草稿；檔案來源已確認，執行事件與中文安全矩形尚未驗證

source_en:
Our {pioneers} have arrived in the New World, Excellency!  They are
ready to look for a good place to build our first colony.  Try to look
for a spot where there will be plenty of food and other resources
available.  Also, our first colony should be built near the ocean so that
our ships can reach it.  Our pioneers are currently equipped
with {100 Tools}, which they can use to clear forests, plow fields,
and build roads.  If we want to make more pioneer units later, we will
need either to bring more Tools from Europe or to have our blacksmiths
manufacture them.
zh_hant: 閣下，我們的{前鋒}已抵達新世界！他們正尋找建立第一座殖民領地的好地點。請找食物和其他資源充足、又靠近海洋的地方，讓船能抵達。前鋒帶著{100件工具}，可用來清除森林、開墾田地及修路。往後若要組建更多前鋒，就得從歐洲運來工具，或請鐵匠自行製造。
notes: 說明語料草稿；檔案來源已確認，執行事件與中文安全矩形尚未驗證

source_en:
Our {soldiers} have two uses.  They can be used to attack our
enemies, if we run across any.  More importantly, they can be used
to protect our own colonies from harm.  Our soldiers are equipped
with {50 Muskets}.  If we want to make more soldier units later on, we
will need either to bring more Muskets from Europe or to have our
gunsmiths manufacture them.  Our soldiers will also become more powerful
if we equip them with {Horses}.
zh_hant: 我們的{士兵}有兩種用途：遇到敵人時可以進攻，更重要的是守護殖民地。他們配備{50支火槍}。日後若要組建更多士兵，就得從歐洲運來火槍，或請槍匠製造。再配備{馬匹}，士兵也會更強。
notes: 說明語料草稿；檔案來源已確認，執行事件與中文安全矩形尚未驗證

source_en: New colonists have arrived in {%STRING0}, Your Excellency!  You can make\nthem citizens of {%STRING0} by clicking on the colony, and then dragging\nthe colonists from the "fence" to a field or building.
zh_hant: 閣下，新殖民地居民已抵達{%STRING0}！點選殖民領地，再把殖民地居民從「圍欄」拖到田地或建築，就能讓他們成為{%STRING0}的殖民地居民。
notes: 說明語料草稿；檔案來源已確認，執行事件與中文安全矩形尚未驗證

source_en:
It is important for every colony to grow enough {food} to feed its
colonists.  Each colonist eats {two} units of food per turn.  Food is
represented by the "corn" icon; if you are not growing enough food
each turn to feed all of your colonists, some of the corn in the colonist
window will be covered with red "X"'es.  To grow more food, turn more of
your colonists into {farmers} or {fishermen}.  You can make individual
farmers more productive by having your pioneers {clear} forests and {plow}
fields.
zh_hant: 每座殖民領地都必須生產足夠的{食物}養活殖民地居民。每位殖民地居民每回合消耗{兩}單位食物。食物以「玉米」圖示表示；若每回合產量不足，殖民地居民視窗中的部分玉米會被紅色叉號遮住。要增加食物，請讓更多殖民地居民擔任{農夫}或{漁夫}；也可以讓前鋒{清除}森林、{耕地}，提高個別農夫的產量。
notes: 說明語料草稿；檔案來源已確認，執行事件與中文安全矩形尚未驗證

source_en:
The European Status Screen shows your home port in %STRING0, %STRING1.
As new immigrants arrive, they will line up on the docks to await transport
to the New World.  You can recruit new immigrants by pressing the {Recruit}
or {Train} buttons.  When ships arrive in the harbor, their cargo can be
sold by dragging it from the cargo holds to the blue warehouses at the bottom
of the screen.  Cargo can also be purchased by dragging it from the warehouse
to a ship's holds.  In the warehouse boxes, the first number indicates the
{bidding} price which the port will pay for that type of cargo.  The second
indicates the {asking} price should you wish to buy that cargo.  To send a
ship back to the New World, click on it or drag it into the "Bound for
%STRING2" box.
zh_hant: 歐洲狀態畫面顯示您位於%STRING0、%STRING1的母國港口。新移民抵達後會在碼頭排隊，等待前往新世界；您可以按{招募}或{訓練}按鈕延攬人手。船隻進港時，把貨物從貨艙拖到畫面底部的藍色倉庫即可出售；從倉庫拖到貨艙則可購買。倉庫方框中的第一個數字是港口收購此貨物的{收購價}，第二個數字是您購買時須付的{售價}。要送船返回新世界，點選船隻，或把它拖到「開往%STRING2」方框。
notes: 說明語料草稿；檔案來源已確認，執行事件與中文安全矩形尚未驗證

source_en:
Cargo is normally purchased in units of 100; when you drag a cargo from
the warehouse to your ship, you are assumed to be loading 100 units.  Since
{%STRING0} costs {%NUMBER0$} per unit and we only have {%NUMBER1$} gold,
we cannot afford 100 units.  If you want to load or unload less than 100
units of cargo onto a ship, simply hold down the {SHIFT} key while you drag
the cargo with the mouse.  You will then be prompted to enter the number
of units you wish to buy.
zh_hant: 貨物通常以100單位為一批購買；把貨物從倉庫拖上船時，預設裝載100單位。由於{%STRING0}每單位要價{%NUMBER0$}，而我們只有{%NUMBER1$}金幣，買不起整批。若要裝卸少於100單位的貨物，請按住{SHIFT}鍵並用滑鼠拖曳，接著輸入要購買的數量。
notes: 說明語料草稿；檔案來源已確認，執行事件與中文安全矩形尚未驗證

source_en:
{Converts} are natives who for one reason or another have decided to
join you and live in your colonies.  Unlike other types of colonist,
converts cannot be educated in new skills.  On the other hand, converts
are better than ordinary colonists at farming, planting, fishing, and
mining.
zh_hant: {歸化者}是因各種原因決定加入我們、住進殖民領地的原住民。不同於其他殖民地居民，他們無法接受教育以習得新技能；但在耕作、種植、捕魚和採礦方面，比一般殖民地居民更擅長。
notes: 說明語料草稿；檔案來源已確認，執行事件與中文安全矩形尚未驗證

source_en:
^^GENERAL INFORMATION
^
This map editor will allow you to create predefined maps for use with
Colonization.  The usual procedure is to create a blank map and then use
the mouse or keyboard to "{paint}" it with terrain.  The {menu tile select}
or {M} function allows you to pick a terrain type to paint with.  Other
features offered include a {coastline protect} which disallows painting on
ocean tiles.  That way, you can determine the shape of your continents by
painting them with a single terrain type while the coastline protect is off;
then, turn coastline protect on and you can paint the proper terrain types
onto your continents without risk of changing their shaopes.  {Fill mode}
allows you to paint broad areas at a single stroke.
^
We recommend that you create maps with no more than 15 distinct land masses.
More than 15 land masses will work, but it may confuse the computer players.
zh_hant:
^^一般說明
^
這個地圖編輯器可建立《殖民帝國》使用的自訂地圖。通常先建立空白地圖，再以滑鼠或鍵盤「{繪製}」地形。{選擇地形圖塊}選單或{M}鍵可挑選要繪製的地形。您也可以啟用{海岸線保護}，禁止修改海洋方格：先關閉保護，以單一地形畫出大陸輪廓；再開啟保護，把合適地形畫到大陸上，而不會破壞輪廓。{填滿模式}則可一次塗繪大片區域。
^
建議地圖上不要超過15塊彼此分離的陸地。更多陸塊仍可使用，但可能讓電腦玩家判斷失準。
notes: 說明語料草稿；檔案來源已確認，執行事件與中文安全矩形尚未驗證

source_en:
^^MOUSE COMMANDS
^
To change the view, simply click either mouse button in the main map area
to cause the view to center on that location.  Or, click on the miniature
world map.
^
To {paint} with the currently selected terrain type, hold down the {shift key}
while pressing the {left} mouse button.  If your currently selected terrain
type is {rivers}, mountains, or hills, that terrain feature will be added on
top of the underlying terrain.  If you want a river to empty into an ocean
square, you must put a "river" in that ocean square.  Rivers must be at least
two tiles long.
^
If you have selected {rivers}, mountains, or hills, hold down the {shift key}
while pressing the {right} mouse button to remove rivers/mtns/hills from the
selected square.
^
Otherwise, the shift key plus the right mouse button causes the terrain
type under the cursor to be {picked up}; it then becomes the selected
terrain type for future drawing.
zh_hant:
^^滑鼠操作
^
要移動畫面視角，請在主地圖區按任一滑鼠鍵，讓視角以該位置為中心；也可以點選縮小的世界地圖。
^
若要用目前選取的地形{繪製}，請按住{Shift鍵}並按滑鼠{左鍵}。若選取的是{河流}、高山或丘陵，該地形特徵會疊加在原有地形上。要讓河流流入海洋方格，該海洋方格也必須放入一段「河流」。河流至少要有兩格長。
^
若選取的是{河流}、高山或丘陵，按住{Shift鍵}並按滑鼠{右鍵}，可從所選方格移除河流、高山或丘陵。
^
在其他情況下，Shift鍵加滑鼠右鍵會{吸取}游標下的地形，使它成為往後繪製時選用的地形。
notes: 說明語料草稿；檔案來源已確認，執行事件與中文安全矩形尚未驗證

source_en:
^^KEYBOARD COMMANDS
^
^The {arrow} keys move the cursor around the map.
^The {Z} and {X} keys control the zoom level.
^The {C} key centers the map on the current cursor location.
^The {M} key allows you to select a terrain type to paint with.
^The {P} key toggles coastline protect mode.
^The {F} key changes the "Fill Radius" (0-2 spaces around cursor).
^
^The {space} or {enter} key paints with the current terrain type.
^The {backspace} key picks up the terrain at the cursor location.
^
If you have selected {rivers, mountains, or hills}, the {space} key or
{enter} key adds that type to the current square; the {backspace} key
removes that type from the current square.
zh_hant:
^^鍵盤操作
^
^{方向鍵}可在地圖上移動游標。
^{Z}與{X}鍵可調整縮放比例。
^{C}鍵可讓地圖以目前游標位置為中心。
^{M}鍵可選擇要繪製的地形。
^{P}鍵可切換海岸線保護。
^{F}鍵可改變「填滿半徑」（游標周圍0至2格）。
^
^{空白鍵}或{Enter鍵}可用目前地形繪製。
^{退格鍵}可吸取游標所在方格的地形。
^
若選取{河流、高山或丘陵}，按{空白鍵}或{Enter鍵}會把該特徵加入目前方格；按{退格鍵}則會移除它。
notes: 說明語料草稿；檔案來源已確認，執行事件與中文安全矩形尚未驗證

source_en:
^^SPECIAL COMMANDS
^
{Coastline Protect}: while coastline protect is on, no changes can be made
to any ocean tiles.  This is useful when you have used a single terrain
type to shape your continents; turn coastline protect on to protect that
shape while you paint your continents with the appropriate terrain.
^
{Fill Radius}: normally, the fill radius is 0, when means that when you
paint you change only the cursor square.  With a fill radius of 1, the
cursor square and all the immediately adjacent squares are painted.  The
fill radius can be set as high as 2.
^
{Find Continents}: when this function is activated, the computer will
check your map to see if it can recognize your continents properly.  You
can play on a map without proper continents, but the AI may become slightly
"dumber" and it may be harder for units to find paths in "Go To" mode.
zh_hant:
^^特殊功能
^
{海岸線保護}：啟用時不能修改海洋方格。您可以先用單一地形畫出大陸輪廓，再開啟保護，在大陸上繪製合適地形而不破壞輪廓。
^
{填滿半徑}：通常設為0，繪製時只改變游標所在方格。設為1時，游標方格及所有相鄰方格都會被繪製；最高可設為2。
^
{尋找大陸}：啟用後，電腦會檢查能否正確辨識地圖上的各塊大陸。即使大陸辨識不完整，地圖仍可遊玩，但電腦玩家可能稍顯遲鈍，單位在「前往」模式下也可能較難尋路。
notes: 說明語料草稿；檔案來源已確認，執行事件與中文安全矩形尚未驗證

^^HOW TO USE PLAYER-CREATED MAPS
^
To play Colonization using a map you have created, run the game normally
(you must have the version of viceroy.exe distributed with this editor;
earlier versions do not support this feature).  From the main menu, select
"Start Game in AMERICA".  A second menu will appear asking if you wish to
play on the original map or a mapeditor-created map.  Select map editor.
Then select the map you wish to play on.
^
Normally, the game will place indian villages randomly.  It is possible,
however, to preassign the general locations of specific tribes if you
want to create a historical scenario.  Create a file with the same name
as your map, but with the extension .MPP (if your map is CARIB.MP, then
create CARIB.MPP).  Use the file TRIBE.TXT, which defines the indian
locations for the America map, as your model.  Do not place more than
84 indian villages.
zh_hant:
^^如何使用玩家自製地圖
^
要使用自製地圖遊玩《殖民帝國》，請照常啟動遊戲（必須使用隨此編輯器提供的viceroy.exe；舊版不支援）。在主選單選擇「在美洲開始遊戲」。接著的選單會問您要使用原始地圖，還是地圖編輯器建立的地圖；請選擇地圖編輯器，再選擇要玩的地圖。
^
通常遊戲會隨機放置印地安人村莊。若要建立歷史情境，也可以預先指定特定部落的大致位置：建立一個與地圖同名、但副檔名為.MPP的檔案（例如地圖為CARIB.MP，就建立CARIB.MPP）。可參照定義美洲地圖印地安人位置的TRIBE.TXT。村莊不要超過84座。
